prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original transparent game prop, a workers' tea station for a rural limestone quarry.
Reference image1 is only the established prop material/ink style. Do not copy its cart, wheels, shafts or cabbages.
Draw a low, wide, waist-high wooden workbench standing solidly on four short stout legs with a simple lower brace. A practical worn plank top has rubbed warm oak edges and a few shallow anonymous scratches, NO writing. Full object in three-quarter elevated view, about30 degrees above horizontal, long front edge receding gently up toward screen-right. Adult human workbench proportions; overall silhouette roughly1.8 times wider than tall including its small tabletop vessels. This is furniture, never a giant kettle icon.
On the bench top place EXACTLY SIX small pale cream stoneware handled cups standing upright in two loose rows of three, all individually countable, beside ONE modest dark charcoal iron kettle with curved spout and low handle. The cups and kettle must be small relative to the bench. At the other end of the tabletop place ONE shallow blue-grey washing bowl with a SEVENTH matching cup resting tilted inside it. The seventh cup has a tiny dark wire repair across its handle, only if cleanly readable. A small folded faded cream cloth sits beside the bowl. No other cups, pots, food, chairs, signs or accessories. Objects rest on the tabletop with plausible contact and overlap; cup handles naturally attached.
Style: original hand-painted game prop coherent with reference, clean thin uniform dark-brown #1b1410 outlines, simple flat base plus one shadow tone per material, restrained cel shading. Dusty neutral wood #8d7d69 and warm brown, muted cream pottery, charcoal kettle, cool muted blue-grey bowl. A few broad wear marks rather than noisy texture. Readable as a workbench with tea equipment at about95px wide, not a close-up still life. No gradients, photographic lighting, 3D render, glow, steam or floating particles.
The entire bench and every foot/vessel must be fully inside the image, generous transparent margin all around. GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no floor, ground patch, cast shadow, background, halo, vignette, caption, grid, text, logo or watermark. One isolated complete prop only. Landscape3:2 canvas preferred, high source resolution for clean downscaling.
status: Source checkpoint; not registered or shipped
